gloss: within the year; by the end of the year

definitions.gloss: within the year; by the end of the year
definitions.explanation: During the rest of the current year, before it ends.

examples.japanese: {年内|ねんない}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わらせる。
examples.english: To finish it within the year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{年内|ねんない}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}する→完成する：25528_kanseisuru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: The construction is due to be completed by the end of the year.

examples.japanese: {年内|ねんない}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三十日|さんじゅうにち}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧し、⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{四日|よっか}→四日：02985_yokka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{開|あ}けます→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。
examples.english: We are open until the 30th this year and reopen on the 4th of January.

notes:
Common in schedules, business and news. {年内|ねんない}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (by year's end) and {年内|ねんない}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ (for the rest of the year) are the usual forms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年内|ねんない}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: within the year, by the end of the year
- {年内|ねんない}いっぱい: right up to the end of the year
- {年内|ねんない}⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜: the last ~ of the year

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧: the end of the year (its last weeks)
- {今年中|ことしじゅう}: some time this year, more conversational
